name: After Article 1; Decision (EU) 2015/1814 – Article 1 – § 5 a
title: REPORT on the proposal for a decision of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Decision (EU) 2015/1814 as regards ceasing the invalidation of allowances in the market stability reserve
part_text: In Article 1 of Decision (EU) 2015/1814, paragraph 5a is replaced by the following : ‘5a. Unless otherwise decided in the first review carried out in accordance with Article 3, from 2031 allowances held in the reserve above 800 million allowances shall no longer be valid. .’
